PDF Page Deleter

Delete pages from a PDF by number or range — preview the page list, select what to remove, and download the cleaned document.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload your PDF.
  2. Enter the page numbers or ranges to delete.
  3. Review which pages will be kept.
  4. Click “Delete pages” and download the new PDF.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I specify which pages to delete?

Type individual pages (2, 5) and ranges (3-7) together, e.g. “2, 5-8, 12”. Pages are 1-based.

Does it affect the remaining pages?

No — only the pages you select are removed; the rest keep their original content and order.

Is my PDF uploaded?

The file stays on your device the whole time — pdf-lib runs locally in your browser.

Are there size limits?

Browsers can struggle with extremely large PDFs (hundreds of MB). For typical documents it works fine.
